extracted.stage: Upcoming hearing in children and finance matter
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether a £2,500 loan for a counsel's fee in a Bristol Family Court children and finance matter, with around £221,000 of assets in dispute, meets the minimum loan size.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received. To consider it further we would need the date of the upcoming hearing, confirmation of the stage of the financial remedy proceedings, and details of the assets in dispute and how they are held. It would also help to have confirmation of your client's details and whether any other funding is in place. We will come back to you once we have had a chance to review the information.
